goals.objective: Investigate without product-code edits why Codex usage collection still fails after ChatGPT login and the app remains on the ChatGPT page; confirm root cause from runtime evidence and report an evidence-bound remediation plan.

successCriteria.scenario: CLI + Android runtime evidence: inspect package/activity/UI/logcat/shared_prefs without product-code edits; PASS when evidence file shows current ChatGPT logged-in surface and exact failing collection timeline.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/codex-login-root-cause-runtime.txt lines 1-44 show installed app, ChatGPT logged-in UI, early about:blank start, auth header loss, 401 usage calls, and stale CONNECTING snapshot | cleanup: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/codex-login-root-cause-cleanup.txt confirms .debug-journal.md and /sdcard/aiquota-window.xml removed

successCriteria.scenario: Hypothesis discrimination: compare at least three hypotheses against runtime timeline and source code lines; PASS when report separates primary cause from downstream symptoms.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/codex-login-root-cause-report.md with hypothesis results and source refs.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/codex-login-root-cause-report.md records H1-H4 and root cause: early about:blank collection blocks analytics redirect and later authless fetches return 401 | cleanup: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/codex-login-root-cause-cleanup.txt

successCriteria.scenario: Scope control: verify temporary debug artifacts were removed and report explicitly treats existing dirty product/test diffs as out-of-scope rather than proving their origin.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/codex-login-root-cause-cleanup.txt shows temporary cleanup and dirty status; .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/codex-login-root-cause-report.md Scope Note states dirty product/test diffs are out of scope and not used as completion evidence.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/codex-login-root-cause-cleanup.txt shows temp files removed and current dirty status; .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/codex-login-root-cause-report.md Scope Note states dirty product/test diffs are out of scope and their origin is not used as completion evidence | cleanup: .debug-journal.md and /sdcard/aiquota-window.xml absent
